title: AdaptTok-Indic: Script-Aware Adaptive Tokenization for Indic Languages
abstract: arXiv:2610.33017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual tokenizers trained on English-dominated corpora often over-segment Indic languages, resulting in longer token sequences and increased tokenization disparity across scripts. We present AdaptTok-Indic, an Indic-specialized extension of adaptive tokenization that combines Unicode-normalized preprocessing with explicit Indic conjunct handling, script-aware routing, and learned byte-level boundary prediction jointly trained with a small Transformer language model. Evaluated on Bengali and Hindi, with additional evaluation on Gujarati, Tamil, and Telugu, AdaptTok-Indic achieves lower token fertility than SentencePiece BPE, an Indic-oriented tokenizer baseline, and an independently implemented MAGNET-style baseline. Across five recorded seeds, mean fertility is 1.432 for Bengali and 1.388 for Hindi, compared with 2.156 and 2.085 for SentencePiece BPE. Recorded downstream scores average 57.69 on evaluated Indic settings versus 50.82

translated_title: AdaptTok-Indic：面向印度语系语言的文字感知自适应分词方法
translated_abstract: 在以英语为主导的语料库上训练的多语言分词器往往会对印度语系语言进行过度切分，导致更长的词元序列以及跨文字系统的分词不均衡问题加剧。我们提出了 AdaptTok-Indic，这是一种针对印度语系语言专门优化的自适应分词扩展方法，它将 Unicode 归一化预处理与显式的印度语系连字处理、文字感知路由以及字节级边界预测相结合，并与一个小型 Transformer 语言模型进行联合训练。在孟加拉语和印地语上的评估结果（此外还对古吉拉特语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语进行了额外评估）显示，AdaptTok-Indic 的词元生育率低于 SentencePiece BPE、一个面向印度语系的分词器基线以及一个独立实现的 MAGNET 风格基线。在记录的五个随机种子中，平均词元生育率为孟加拉语 1.432、印地语 1.388，而 SentencePiece BPE 分别为 2.156 和 2.085。记录的下游任务平均得分在所评估的印度语系设置中为 57.69，对比基线为 50.82。
tldr: AdaptTok-Indic 是一种专为印度语系语言设计的自适应分词方法，通过 Unicode 归一化预处理、连字处理、文字感知路由和字节级边界预测的联合训练，显著降低了孟加拉语和印地语的词元生育率，并提升了下游任务表现。
en_tdlr: AdaptTok-Indic is a script-aware adaptive tokenizer for Indic languages that combines Unicode-normalized preprocessing, explicit conjunct handling, script-aware routing, and learned byte-level boundary prediction, achieving much lower token fertility and better downstream scores than SentencePiece BPE and other baselines on Bengali and Hindi.
